subject: Hosted IO baseline: per-1M unit breakdown & supported models
messages:
From: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Tan <emily@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2029 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API — need per-1M token IO split + supported models

Hi Ava,

Quick intro: I'm Ryan (Head of Engineering at Greenfield Health). We're evaluating hosted inference vendors for a patient-facing summarization and triage assistant. Before we schedule a call, could you send a simple baseline breakdown showing:

- Standard per-1M-token input and output rates for hosted API (separate IO pricing)
- Which hosted model SKUs are eligible on the platform (we care about both 7B and 13B families + any quantized variants)
- Any volume-discount tiers or pilot discounts you typically offer for startups doing a 3-month pilot

Our ballpark expected usage for an initial pilot is ~2–4M tokens/month (mostly output-heavy—roughly 1:3 input:output). Also curious about latency SLOs for the supported models.

Thanks — a concise table or PDF is perfect.

—Ryan
Ryan Cole
Head of Engineering, Greenfield Health
ryan.cole@greenfieldhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API — need per-1M token IO split + supported models

Hi Ryan — thanks for the note and context. Attaching our baseline ratecard (PDF) which includes per-1M token input/output splits, supported hosted SKUs, and standard volume tiers. Quick highlights from the attachment:

- Baseline (hosted API, standard tier):
  • rwd-7B-v1: $3.00 per 1M input | $9.00 per 1M output
  • rwd-13B-v2: $7.50 per 1M input | $22.50 per 1M output
  • rwd-34B-quant: $18.00 per 1M input | $54.00 per 1M output
- Supported open variants: meta-llama-2-7b, meta-llama-2-13b (availability may vary by region)
- Pilot guidance: for 3-month pilots under 5M tokens/month we typically offer a one-time pilot credit or a 20% introductory discount on IO rates (subject to pilot terms).
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile for rwd-7B ~120–200ms (single-request, standard payload); larger models higher depending on sequence length.

If you can confirm expected monthly tokens and whether you want guaranteed latency (SLA) vs best-effort, we can produce a short mutual action plan and a firm pilot quote.

Attaching: Hosted_Baseline_Ratecard_Q1_2029.pdf, GFH_usage_estimate_template.xlsx

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Mar 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fw: Hosted API — need per-1M token IO split + supported models (internal)

Looping in a quick internal recommendation before we send a formal quote back to Greenfield. Points to agree on:

- For a 3-month pilot at 2–4M tokens/month (output-heavy 1:3), offer the 20% pilot discount on IO rates OR a $2k pilot credit, whichever is more attractive to them.
- If they commit to a 12-month reserve at >=20M tokens/month after pilot, tiered discounts: 15% at 20–50M, 25% at 50–200M, 35% 200M+.
- To keep margin predictable on hosted, we should suggest rwd-7B as the default pilot SKU (best latency/cost balance). If they want higher fidelity, offer rwd-13B with 10% higher pilot discount cap.
- Include a short note on fallback: we can route to quantized variants for cost-sensitive traffic with slight quality tradeoff.

Aditya — can you confirm we can commit to the 95th percentile latency numbers for rwd-7B in us-west and that pilot discount is approvable without legal complexities? Also please attach any marketplace listing links we should include.

—Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Hi Ryan — following up with a concise snapshot and next steps (see below and attached PDF). Thanks for the usage estimate — that helped us pick a practical pilot SKU and pricing.

Snapshot (pilot, 3 months, estimated 3M tokens/month, input:output 1:3):
- Recommended pilot SKU: rwd-7B-v1 (hosted)
- List rates (per 1M tokens): $3.00 input | $9.00 output
- Pilot offer: 20% off IO rates for 3 months (effective pilot rate: $2.40 input | $7.20 output) OR a $2,000 pilot credit (you pick)
- Estimated monthly cost (post-discount, 3M tokens): ~ $18.72 (input) + $64.8 (output) = $83.52/month — note: numbers rounded; final invoiceable amounts use tokenized counts from the API logs

Other notes:
- Supported models are listed in the attached ratecard; we can enable meta-llama-2 variants in us-west but they are not SLA-backed by default.
- SLA: for rwd-7B we can commit to an operational SLO (95th pct) around 200ms in us-west for typical short sequences; formal SLA available with Dedicated or Private deployments.
- Next steps: if this looks good I can create a short pilot MPA and a HubSpot opportunity. If you prefer a quick convo, I'm available Fri 3/15 09:00–12:00 PT.
